column1: # The issue labels, synced to GitHub by `mise run gh:labels` (gh label create --force).
# name<TAB>colour (hex, no #)<TAB>description. Tabs, not spaces: a name may hold spaces.
# Syncing creates or updates these and deletes nothing, so a label removed here
# must be deleted on GitHub by hand. cmd/irgo-winvm/issue_test.go checks that every
# label the issue forms, `report -issue` and docs/CONTRIBUTING.md name is here.
